functions.name: enforce_master_stock
me_role
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.me_role()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ select role from users where tg_id = me_tg() $function$

functions.name: me_tg
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.me_tg()
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$ select nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true)::json->>'tg_id','')::bigint $function$

functions.name: me_venue
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.me_venue()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ select venue_id from users where tg_id = me_tg() $function$

stock_triggers: CREATE TRIGGER stock_master_guard BEFORE UPDATE ON public.stock FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_master_stock()
